ios.desc:
Workona lets you organize everything for a project within workspaces. Use the Workona iPad & iPhone apps to:

• Access your workspaces on the go, putting cloud docs & links at your fingertips
• Access tabs you have open on your computer from your iPad or iPhone
• Keep projects up-to-date when you’re away from the desktop
• Add a tab or resource to a workspace from the iOS share button

The iPad app offers a full-featured browser built for work:

• Seamlessly transition between your workspaces & tabs
• Search your saved resources from the browser address bar
• Manage tabs without interrupting your flow

Workona helps solve the problems of modern work:

• You can’t find the work you need - Workspaces put everything for a project in one place, so your important docs & links are easy to find
• You need a laptop to get real work done - The Workona iPad & iPhone apps are designed for serious work, allowing you to travel light
• Your browser is messy and disorganized - Workspaces display your open tabs at a glance, so you can rapidly close and organize tabs
• You need your work on the go - The Workona app syncs your open tabs, acting like a portal into your desktop browser

“Workona has enhanced my productivity more than any other tool I use” – Ed Bott, ZDNet
